articles.title: ‘I Understood Modi’s Discomfort With Ruling Elite’: Sonia Gandhi Reveals Her Common Ground With PM
articles.description: In her memoir Belonging, former Congress president Sonia Gandhi reflects on her relationship with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, acknowledging that despite their sharply contrasting ideologies, they share some common ground. Sonia says she understood Modi’s discomfort with the ruling elite, recalling how she too often felt disconnected from privileged political circles in Delhi. She writes that Modi had worked his way to power within the RSS from an underprivileged background, while emphasising that their visions of India remain vastly different. Sonia describes their political rivalry as ideological rather than personal, rooted in contrasting ideas of inclusiveness, secularism and social justice. She also reveals that she has had practically no real contact with Modi, describing their interactions as formal and limited to official gatherings.

articles.title: Usman Khawaja Details Ball Tampering Scandal In New Autobiography Sabr
articles.description: In his new autobiography 'Sabr', Usman Khawaja sheds light on the 2018 ball-tampering scandal, detailing the use of sandpaper during the Gqeberha Test and revealing how the Australian team collectively managed the ball's condition.

articles.title: Google cybersecurity company Wiz flew employees to Thailand, company with roots in Israel made Katy Perry perform at the offsite event; her appearance has sparked protests as ...
articles.description: Wiz, a cybersecurity firm under Google's wing, hosted a lavish five-day retreat in Thailand, featuring a performance by Katy Perry. However, the event sparked considerable online controversy, as critics highlighted the company's ties to Israel and opulent gatherings. This isn't the first time Perry has faced backlash; she previously encountered protests during an Australian performance. Wiz's penchant for high-profile events has drawn scrutiny from various quarters.

articles.title: Sanju Samson’s latest viral video has nothing to do with cricket, here's why fans are praising him
articles.description: Sanju Samson celebrated Diwali by visiting an old-age home, where he served food to elderly residents, interacted with them and posed for photographs. A video shared by the Sanju Samson Foundation has crossed five million views. Established in 2023, the foundation was co-founded by Samson and Charulatha Remesh.
